My wife and I had dinner and drinks at Wolf on Friday evening 6/26/26.
We had wanted to try it for some time but they reserve out quickly.
With the exception of a minimum $17 valet charge, they give you the option of paying $17, $22, or $27 for the valet parking, we could not have been more impressed.
We have been to several of her restaurants in LA and Los Vegas and Lisa out did herself decorating Wolf. The entire place is breathtaking.
From the moment we checked in at the front desk each person we spoke with, from hostess to manager was perfectly dressed, perfectly trained, and very well spoken.
Anna, our server made the evening even more enjoyable helping us choose our meal.
We started off with their bread service. An entire loaf of the best bread ever with two different house made butters.
I had their Little Gem Ceasar salad to start. It was anything but little. In fact I am having half with my dinner at home this evening.
We both ordered the Sea Bass. My wife with sauce on the side like everything she eats and me as the chef prepares it. We eat sea bass all.over the world and both decided the sea bass at Wolf is best ever. Never tasted anything so good.
The drinks, food, ambience, people watching, music, and our server Anna made the evening unforgettable.
We already have our favorite table, 56 and favorite server, Anna for our next reservation.
Everyone needs to experience Wolf.

reviews.text:
If you're visiting Scottsdale, Wolf is an absolute must-try and a dining experience you won't soon forget. My husband and I celebrated his birthday here, and from start to finish, the evening exceeded every expectation.

Of course, we had to order the famous Goat Cheese Balls, and they absolutely lived up to the hype. For cocktails, I enjoyed the Sheep's Clothing, which arrived with whimsical house-made cotton candy, while my husband chose the smoked Cry Wolf—both were as creative as they were delicious.

For dinner, I opted for the Risotto, which featured enormous, perfectly cooked shrimp and was rich without feeling too heavy. My husband ordered the Short Rib Bolognese, and it was incredible—hearty, comforting, and generously topped with what had to be nearly half a pound of tender, flavorful short rib.

What truly elevated our experience, however, was our server, Paulina. She was warm, personable, and genuinely made us feel like valued guests. Beyond providing thoughtful menu recommendations, she also shared fantastic suggestions for exploring the greater Phoenix area, making our visit even more memorable. To top off the evening, she surprised my husband with a birthday dessert—a decadent brownie served with vanilla bean ice cream—which was the perfect ending to a wonderful celebration.

Wolf is absolutely worth the price point for the quality of the food, creative cocktails, exceptional service, and unforgettable atmosphere. A heartfelt thank you to the entire team, and especially to Paulina, for making my husband's birthday so special. We can't wait to return!

Wolf by Vanderpump was cute and I’d honestly go back.

The bread was just bread, but it was soft and airy and really good in that way. The sauces were great the orange is better The lobster tacos were good though they were in this crispy wonton-type shell, and that actually worked amazing. The goat cheese balls was probably my least favorite thing.

The yucca fries also weren’t that good. I’ve definitely had better yucca fries, but I also wasn’t expecting them to be life-changing from a Vanderpump-type restaurant. The truffle fries, though, were really good and probably one of the best things we ordered.

We also got some kind of pita/chip-and-dip platter, and that was good. I didn’t try the spaghetti Bolognese, but it came with these big thick pasta pieces and looked solid. Someone else got the pesto risotto and apparently it was good, but I don’t really like risotto, so I skipped it. The table also got chicken adobo and steak, and everyone seemed to like their food.

Mac and cheese also was good. I’d go back, mainly for the lobster wonton things, truffle fries, and the experience. Not just saying this as a watcher of vanderpump rules.

The brisket and tri tip bolognese, and Ken’s Haddock ‘n’ chips were both amazing. The atmosphere was so nice and very clean. The service was all around great, but Lexi was our server and she was so awesome! She was very friendly, had great recommendations and was a joy to chat with. Definitely recommend Wolf by Vanderpump!
reviews.author: Bryan M

reviews.text:
We had such an amazing experience at Wolf by Vanderpump! From the moment we walked in, everything was top-notch. The food was absolutely delicious, beautifully presented, and full of flavor. The drinks were truly to die for—creative, perfectly crafted, and some of the best cocktails we’ve had in a long time.

A huge shoutout to our server, Emily, who was incredibly friendly, attentive, and made us feel so welcome throughout the entire meal. The managers also stopped by to check on us and were just as warm and accommodating, which really elevated the experience.

Between the stunning atmosphere, outstanding food and drinks, and exceptional service, this was a dining experience we’ll definitely be talking about for a while. We can’t wait to come back!

reviews.text: From the minute we walked in the door till the very end absolutely amazing! The goat cheese balls are everything I imagined and the pump Tini a must!

reviews.text: We stopped in on the evening of Monday June 1st at the Lake Tahoe location to try the goat cheese balls and a few drinks. We have a wonderful table, the atmosphere was great and our server Anna was phenomenal! We immediately decided we needed to make a reservation to come back for dinner. We made a reservation for Friday June 5th at 9:30, we requested to be sat in Anna's section because we had such a good experience with her Monday. She instantly remembered us and what appetizer we would be trying that night from our conversation on Monday. She gave us another phenomenal experience. She is truly a wonderful server and went out of her way to make sure we were taken care of and had a great experience. We could not be more pleased with the food, atmosphere and service at this restaurant. If we are ever in the area again, we will definitely be heading back!

reviews.text: Absolutely incredible experience at Wolf! The food was amazing, the drinks were next-level, and every detail felt thoughtful and elevated. It is on the pricey side but worth it for the experience. Can’t wait to come back!

reviews.text: I enjoyed this place even though they were still working out the grand opening kinks at the time.  The staff was a little undertrained but that's to be expected since they just opened.  The shrimp and cocktails were great, as was the presentation.  The ambience was really well done, I'd say even better than the Vanderpump places in LA and Vegas.  I'd go back again now that they have their sea-legs.
reviews.author: Erik Shellenberger

reviews.text:
For our daughter's birthday celebration we wanted good food and excellent service, we got just that what an amazing experience! First our waiter Barret D was beyond outstanding!! I am a Vanderpump Rules fan, the real reason we picked it, and loved his knowledge of not only the restaurant but the show! We started with the Signature Wolf Bread that was fantastic, next we had the Famous Goat Cheese Balls and one of their mocktails, Berry S***. For our meals we tried the Beurre Blanc Salmon, Colossal Shrimp Tacos and the Brisket & Tri-Tip Bolognese. I must say out of all three dishes the Brisket & Tri-Tip Bolognese was outstanding, melt in your mouth delicious!
Now, let's get to the couple of items that might be a deal breaker for some, they charge an additional 3.5% Venue Admin Fee on your final bill, I did not ask what it was for but for sure not a fan. Secondly, most tables are outstanding and comfortable, however, as I pointed out in my photos a few tables have stools as chairs and sitting in them for an entire dinner service would be an issue for me and my husband so if your the same, and making reservations, you may want to mention you do not want these tables. Thank you Barret for creating an extraordinary dinner experience for our family, we will be back!
reviews.author: Brandy Sunshine

reviews.text: This place was pricey but cool!!! Went for drinks. Sat outside at night and the atmosphere was chill and relaxing. Bartender had never made my drink before but was willing to learn something new. 👍🏾👍🏾
reviews.author: tea payt

reviews.text: I made reservations for the evening of my birthday in March at 7 PM. The person who answers the phone is absolutely incompetent.  When I made the initial reservation she said thank you and hung up. She never addressed me by my name and did not send a confirmation email. I called back to say did you put the reservation in my name and she said yes I did and repeated my name to me.  I wonder why when she took the call she didn’t say thank you Ms. AP for the Reservation. I called back just now to confirm the reservation and every single thing I said I had to repeat because she was not paying attention. She also told me that my she didn’t have a reservation for me on Thursday night. I am moving on.  When I think about an upscale restaurant experience, I think about it from beginning to end. Beginning with the initial phone call: having a competent person on the telephone. I am quite sure the food is great. I am quite sure it’s a wonderful place to dine, but I just cannot do stupid.  If you cannot train the person who answers the phones how to answer the phone correctly and professionally I really do question what my experience actually will be like: I question your service people, I question your chef I wonder what my $500 experience will actually be like no thanks.  Good training matters.
reviews.author: Agi Dyer

reviews.text: I had the privilege to dine at Wolf this past week, and Barrett was my server. He made the experience so much more lovely and enjoyable. I would definitely dine here again and would hope that he was my server. I had the Chilean Seabass, and it was phenomenal. Thank you to Barrett and Wolf for a lovely dinner.

reviews.text: The food is so disgusting. Chicken Caesar wrap tastes like it could’ve been made at wendy’s. Service was fantastic, but lunch was a major waste of money.

reviews.text:
My wife and I came to Wolf for birthday celebrations and this restaurant is special! The interior decor is very charming and intimate, and the vibes here are awesome. They had a live DJ on Saturday night to create a nice dinner atmosphere.

Our favorite highlights were the Wagyu sliders and Chilean seabass along with all of the signature cocktails. One important thing about this place is that you’ll definitely need a reservation during the weekend given its popularity so be sure to book atleast 1-2 weeks in advance if you want a good time.

Overall, this is a wonderful date spot in Scottsdale if you’re trying to impress your date and want to dress up!

reviews.text: Emily made our experience. First visit and we had a great time. Thanks Emily!

reviews.text: The decor is really gorgeous- from the chandeliers to the high back chairs at the tables for two.  Music was very loud- like club loud.  They were running 30 mins behind on reservations so we opted to sit at the bar.  The service was great! Started with the fried goat cheese balls and the Campari tomatoes.  Really strong garlic oil on the Campari tomatoes.  I’m a sucker for anything with goat cheese! The Filet mignon and NY strip were prepared perfectly.  The parsnips puree and potatoes Anna were really tasty.  Finished with the stonefruit cobbler and it was kinda bland IMO but there was a little heat to it- I won’t tell the secret ingredient (we chatted with the chef about it).  Overall we enjoyed our night there and would go again.

reviews.text: When I say Amy was absolutely amazing.!!!!!! She by far was the star of the show.! Professionalism is top tier! She just was so personable. The food was absolutely out of this world. Will be back soon

reviews.text: From the moment we came in we were very impressed with the staff, the environment, and food options. Our server was very attentive to our every need and left no need unmet. The tri tip & brisket bolognese was incredible as well as the FAMOUS goat cheese balls. We ended up getting the Churros for desert and they were to die for. I was feeling tired and requested an espresso martini and was provided a freshly made espresso shot in my martini and it really perked me up. From the start to finish we enjoyed our experience and would definitely recommend this place to others looking for a 5 stars experience!

reviews.text: Wolf is exactly something you’d imagine by Lisa Vanderpump. The dining experience was wonderful, the attention to detail in the restaurant decor, the ambiance, the atmosphere were all excellent. The food was delicious, I had the berry sexy mocktail and the brisket & tri-tip bolognese which was delicious. Service was great, and as someone who spent over a decade as a server and bartender, it’s hard to find  great service. I will definitely be returning on my next trip to Phoenix area.

reviews.text: First of the atmosphere is gorgeous! So many beautiful details in every corner. The servers are amazing. So friendly but honestly Emy and Amy are the best! They really made our experience epic! 10 out of 10. Food is delicious as well.

reviews.text:
My husband and I came here expecting a high-quality culinary experience to match the hype, but unfortunately, the food was a massive disappointment. There is absolutely no flavor at this restaurant. Everything is unseasoned and as plain as white paper.

The Food: We started with the $35 bread service, which was incredibly dry, lacked texture, and had a harsh, overwhelming yeast smell. The Caesar salad had an overpowering piece of anchovy that ruined the bite. For mains, the bowl of pasta was completely bland, unseasoned, and low quality. The burger was advertised as Wagyu but lacked quality and flavor entirely. We ultimately had to send both the pasta and the burger back because they were inedible for the price point.

The Service: The only saving grace of the evening was the staff. Our server, Nicole, was absolutely amazing and did everything she could to take care of us. The manager, Patrick, also stepped in and tried his best to remedy the situation.

If you are looking for amazing quality Italian or Mexican cuisine in the area where the chef truly knows their stuff, I highly recommend going to The Taliano or Mexicana by Chef Joey instead. For the prices charged here, the food quality needs a serious overhaul.

reviews.text: I set the bar high for this one, since I have been to the majority of Vanderpumps past and present restaurant ventures. The first time here was my mother's birthday and everyone from the host to the chef made my beautiful mother feel like she was a star, and she is one. The first time, I was not sold that the food at Wolf was as good or on par with SUR. I am in Love with SUR and The Vanderpump à Paris, holds a special place in my heart. I was devastated to see PUMP lose it's spot in WeHo, and I think TomTom is genius. I wanted to celebrate my friend, who just launched his own business, and I immediately booked a reservation for my second time at Wolf, and I had the same experience. Everyone was so incredible to my friend and I, from the time we were greeted to how wonderful our server was. The fish and chips was mind blowing and the atmosphere at Wolf is not only chic, but it also has a smooth silky calmness to the atmosphere. It was absolutely divine. I only give the food four stars because as of right now I think they could expand the menu a tad, other than that it is five out of five. reviews.text: Came her for lunch with my daughter.  It took 20 minutes to even get a glass of water.  30 minutes after we order a drink it finally arrived.  It's not even busy so no excuse.  We've been waiting for an hour for our food and it still hasn't arrived.  Save yourself from being pissed off and just go anywhere other than here.

reviews.text:
There is nothing like saying 'I love you' to your Mom on Mother's Day like a 45 minute wait past reservation time, and heat lamp Prime Rib.
I'm not sure where in the world of culinary arts they taught that you want both bad service and food, but wherever they do, they should give Wolf by Vanderpump the award for best in class!

Truly a disappointment to say the least. Take your money elsewhere, especially in Scottsdale.  There are plenty of other restaurants that still know how to create delicious food with an excellent service experience.
reviews.author: Morgan-kenzie Davies

reviews.text:
Let's paint a picture...It's Mother's Day and you spend the day waiting for lunch at Wolf by Vanderpump. 11 adults and 2 kids. Reservation at 1pm, 75% of the party has arrived, they state, we can't sit you until the full party arrived. 1:15pm, full party arrived, table not ready.
1:20pm, they tell us it'll be a little bit until table it ready, they tell us they will sit in the lounge with a couple comped champagne bottles. 1:45pm, they take us to our table outside in the 105° weather (luckily with shade and misters). We order everything as soon as we can, the waits continue with appetizers and mains. Set menus and they still couldn't produce highly quality foods and service. Appetizers ,they were good. Entree's, not so much. We sent prime rib back because they decided to prepare and cut meats and let sit until heat lamps for probably 10+ minutes. I'd rather have my prime rib cut and served at Golden Corral. Pictures included.
$900 spent, even with 20% off after everything.
First and last time time we will be there. And will not recommend to other family or friends.
I get everyone's experience is different, but this was ours on a special day.
reviews.author: Sheyenne Dodds

reviews.text:
Avoid WOLF by Vanderpump on holidays unless you want to massively overpay for a disappointing and poorly executed meal.

The only redeeming part of our Mother’s Day brunch was Nicole, who was an excellent waitress, and the staff overall was friendly and clearly trying their best. Unfortunately, the kitchen and management completely dropped the ball.

The Mother’s Day menu only had about five items, all outrageously overpriced for the quality and portion sizes. To make matters worse, it took over an hour for our food to arrive despite the extremely limited menu.

And the food itself was terrible. The French toast came out raw in the middle, and the tuna tostada tasted noticeably fishy and not fresh. For a restaurant positioning itself as upscale, serving food of that quality at those prices is unacceptable.

The entire experience felt disorganized, overpriced, and driven more by aesthetics than actual food or hospitality. Beautiful decor can’t make up for bad food, long waits, and a poorly planned holiday service

reviews.text: Went to Wolf for a Mother’s Day celebration.   Everything was absolutely amazing.  The cocktails,  food and the service.  The goat cheese balls live up to the hype!!!  We loved the cozy ambiance and just thoroughly enjoyed our experience.

I wasn’t going to write this review as my dinner was a couple weeks ago but then I received word that other people had the same experience. So here it is….

Atmosphere is gorgeous and unique, but what’s the point if the service is trash. They don’t allow you to sit til your whole group is there, which is fine, except we waited 45 min to be seated past our reservation with the whole group there.

Drinks were not worth the hype and the only thing in the menu I would debate eating again was the fish tacos. Our group also sent a couple items back.

Our service at the table was horrible! Would see the server 1 time every 30 minutes…

Idk why the reviews are so high…

reviews.text: Went for my Mother’s Day today.  Service was slow.  Never brought a beer to my husband.  Didn’t bring salt/pepper.  Every food item was bad.  An actual anchovie in my salad ( I hate fish) .  The steak salads came out ice cold like frozen in the middle and literally not cooked.  Breakfast potato’s were as hard as croutons.  The drinks were good.  Manager comped the food but to place an automatic 20% tip on the full order when it was horrible and service was horrible.  Came home to eat a burrito i made last night.  Just crazy suppose to be fine dining but oreganos would have been better.  Extremely disappointed and we won’t be back.
reviews.author: debbie deb

reviews.text:
We chose to spend Mother’s Day here expecting a nice meal with family, and it honestly ended up being one of the most disappointing dining experiences we’ve ever had. We had a 1:00 reservation for 11 people and 2 kids, yet we still waited nearly an hour just to be seated. Standing around with hungry children on a busy holiday completely defeated the point of making a reservation in the first place.

The manager came over at one point and brought two bottles of champagne, which we appreciated, but after we asked for orange juice he disappeared and never came back. That pretty much set the tone for the rest of the experience. Once we were finally seated, the service only continued to go downhill.

As soon as we sat down, we immediately ordered all of our appetizers to try and speed things along, but somehow it still took 45 minutes just to get appetizers to the table. From there, everything only got worse. Our table was rarely checked on, drinks stayed empty forever, and it constantly felt like we were forgotten.

What made it even worse was the food itself. Nearly everything came out cold, dry, or clearly sitting under a heat lamp far too long before making it to the table. Some meals were incorrect, and by the time food actually arrived, nobody even wanted to complain anymore because we had already spent so much time waiting. For the prices this restaurant charges, the quality was honestly unacceptable.

The most frustrating part is that after all of this, we still spent nearly $900 on this meal. For that amount of money, you expect good service, hot food, and at the very least a restaurant that can handle reservations properly on a holiday. Instead, the entire experience felt disorganized, ignored, and disappointing from start to finish.

The manager did discount part of our bill, which is the only reason this review isn’t one star, but a small discount doesn’t make up for a ruined Mother’s Day lunch. I would absolutely not return and would strongly recommend reading reviews carefully before dining here, especially during holidays.

reviews.text: We visited on Mother’s Day, and I was surprised by the super limited menu for the day. Really limited our ability to try the menu. No kids options, so our child had bacon and the brownie. Service was just ok, so I was surprised to see that on top of the high prices, they charged 3.5% for Venue Admin Fee??? Super confused on who gets that and why we are being charged that. Parking is not validated, so add $12 for that. Overall, not stellar, outside of the decor.

I had the salmon and it didn't have much flavor and it was a bit too greasy. The veggies that it came with were supposed to be steamed but they were hard and the cauliflower was almost raw. My husband had the bolonaise and again, he wasn't impressed. Not sure that we will be back but it was an experience nonetheless!

reviews.text: The decor is on brand. Garish. Weird animal statues everywhere. Really makes you wonder if Lisa is trying to see what she can get corporate dollars to pay for. Food was actually good. Like good, not good for a Caesars property. On parking with Scottsdale pricing. Bartenders are elite, servers a touch aloof.

reviews.text:
I take no pleasure in writing this review; however, the experience was significant enough that I felt compelled to share it.

We arrived for our reservation on time and were seated later than expected. While that was somewhat disappointing, it was not a major issue. Within a few minutes, we were given water and informed that our server would be with us shortly.

Unfortunately, after nearly 20 minutes, we still had not been greeted by a server. Meanwhile, a group seated next to us approximately five minutes after our arrival had already been promptly attended to, received their cocktails, and placed their dinner order.

My husband and I dine out frequently due to our demanding work schedules, and we had very high expectations for Wolf by Vanderpump. While I can honestly say the ambiance and overall atmosphere were exceptional, the level of service did not reflect the same standard.

As we decided to leave, I asked to speak with a manager. I was genuinely upset by the experience, as this level of inattentiveness and disparity in service is simply unacceptable.

reviews.author: Rose T

reviews.text:
We had a very disappointing experience at Wolf by Vanderpump during a birthday celebration this past Saturday.
Our reservation was at 2:30 PM. We were seated and ordered drinks and appetizers, but after the second round of drinks, service slowed down significantly. It took nearly two hours before we were able to order dinner. When the dinner orders finally arrived, they were incorrect.
Throughout the meal, our table was left with dirty appetizer plates and empty drink glasses. We spoke with a manager about the issues, but there was very little urgency or accountability. After almost four hours, we had enough and asked to speak with a higher-level manager. We were told the manager was “on the 8th floor,” which made it feel like no one truly wanted to address the situation.
The food portion of the bill was credited, but the overall experience was still extremely disappointing. For a restaurant connected to the Caesars Hotel Group and the Vanderpump name, we expected much better service, better management, and a much more professional guest experience.
Unfortunately, this was not the birthday celebration we had hoped for. Based on our visit, the restaurant appears poorly managed and lacking the level of service expected at this type of venue.

Unfortunately, the rest of the experience fell short. We came in around 2 PM when it was slow, yet service was extremely slow with only two servers on. We were never checked on after our food arrived and had to flag our server down each time. The chimichurri steak wrap was so off in both smell and taste that we honestly had to spit it out. Even the iced latte tasted like basic coffee with milk. Beautiful setting, but major issues with food quality and service.

Our server did try to make it up to us by taking care of the whole tab, but I felt bad so I offered to pay for something.

reviews.text: Their menu says one thing and they give you another. We ordered the Cheese Please which looks beautiful on Instagram and below is what we got. Two types of blue cheese a chive cheese and 3 types of salami. No nuts, no olives, crackers, gerkins or any diversity. This was obviously left over hotel and salad cheese. When we asked the server about the difference she brought us out some nuts in a quarter measuring cup and some tomatoes and said she hoped this made up the difference. Drinks that said they would have gold flakes (The Gold Water/Gold Rush) didn't have any. We also ordered shots and the menu said $10 and we were charged $20 per shot. Crazy disappointed especially because I have been to many Vanderpump establishments and have always had a good time.

Lipstick on a Pig

I really wanted to like this place but wow, what a disappointment.

Service was painfully slow. It took two full hours to get our food, and that pretty much set the tone for the entire experience. After we placed our order, our waiter just…left our giant menus sitting on the table. We eventually had to ask for them to be taken away, which, honestly, even Denny’s manages to do without being prompted.

The seating didn’t help either. The chairs were so low it felt like we were practically eating off a kids table. At one point I’m pretty sure I could’ve rested my chin on the table. By then, we’d been waiting so long we joked we should just use the awkward seating position to take a nap.

Appetizers finally came out…with no plates. We waited another five minutes for those, so naturally everything started getting cold. The “smoked” wings? Purely theatrical and ZERO actual smoked flavor.

Then came the steaks…cold. And just to keep the theme going, we had to wait another four minutes just to get a fork.

The whole experience was frustrating because the space itself is beautifully designed. I had hoped this could be a go-to spot for hosting high-end clients, but there’s no way I’d bring anyone here after this. I’ll stick with places that actually deliver on both atmosphere and service.

To top it off, they labeled our table of six as a “large party” and automatically added a 20% gratuity plus a random 3.5% hotel fee.

Hard pass. I do NOT recommend this place.

reviews.text: We made a reservation three weeks in advance. The reservation was for 7:30 PM. We arrived at 7:00 PM knowing that we were early and would likely go to the rooftop for a drink ahead of dinner. This was for our one year wedding anniversary. When we arrived, the host informed us that our reservation would more than likely not be seated on time, even arriving 30 minutes early we would still be seated late. We headed to the rooftop, where the glass of wine I purchased was a 5 ounce pour for $17, in a clear plastic solo cup. My husband ordered a beer, the bartender let him know that it would be warm because they did not have a working refrigerator. When we asked if there were beer options that were cold, he replied no. We returned to the host stand at 7:30 PM, and again we’re told we would be seated late. We were seated at 7:50 PM. The table we were sat at was nice, next to a window, and had a good view. The server was excellent, and attentive. She did give us a free shot for our wedding anniversary. The goat cheese balls were dry and there was no side or sauce to pair with it. I will say the Vanderpump Cabernet was good. I got a burger, which was delicious. My husband got the fish and chips. We ordered the appetizer and food at the same time. After about 30 minutes past receiving our appetizer, our server came to our table to inform us the fish, for the fish and chips, was being thawed which is why our entrée was taking so long. They did comp the meal, which was very generous. However, at a five star restaurant owned by Lisa Vanderpump, I was shocked to hear she was serving frozen fish. We did not get dessert. Overall, I would give the experience a two out of five stars, the ambience of course was beautiful, but aside from our server, the service was below average, the food was average, and the experience overall was disappointing.

reviews.text:
Birthday Dinner at Wolf by Vanderpump – Caesars Republic Scottsdale

My birthday dinner at Wolf by Vanderpump in Scottsdale was an experience I won’t forget anytime soon.

From the moment we arrived at the hostess stand, there was an immediate sense of excitement and curiosity. The décor felt like stepping into an enchanting world — rich textures of fur, glimmering crystals, and dramatic chains created an atmosphere that was both adventurous and romantic. It felt like the beginning of a beautiful story unfolding for the evening.

For my birthday, I told my husband my only wish was simple: a sunset dinner with a view of Camelback Mountain. When we were seated, it felt as if the team at Wolf had conspired to make that wish come true.

Our server, Rebecca, became our North Star for the evening — guiding us through the forest of incredible cocktails and dishes with warmth, confidence, and a genuine sense of hospitality.

I ordered the Wolfberry (Blackberry Lambrusco Spritz) — refreshing, vibrant, and the perfect celebratory cocktail — while my husband stayed true to his classic Elijah Craig Small Batch, neat.

We began with The Famous Goat Cheese Balls, and they absolutely lived up to the reputation. Crispy on the outside with a creamy, decadent center, they become something magical once dipped into the Hatch chile hot honey. Each bite was an explosion of sweet heat and rich texture.

Next came the Wolf Bread, made with Arizona’s Noble Bread Company. Rebecca shared that this bread is exclusive to the Scottsdale Wolf location — a detail that made it feel even more special. If you know good bread, you know… this one is worth savoring.

Then the Smoked Cowboy Wings arrived with theatrical flair. The server placed the dish on the table and lifted the lid, releasing a swirl of aromatic smoke that immediately captured the table. For a moment it felt like something wild had entered the room — smoky, bold, and irresistible. The wings were hot, crispy, and juicy in perfect balance.

Just when we thought we had ordered enough, we saw a stunning plate of fish and chips pass by our table — the kind of dish that instantly triggers FOMO. We stopped the server to ask about it and learned it was Ken’s Haddock ‘N’ Chips. Rebecca, sensing our curiosity, saved the moment by boxing up our wings so we could try it — and we were glad we did. Perfectly crisp batter, delicate fish, and comforting flavor that made us pause between bites.

Then something magical happened.

The restaurant shades lifted and the windows quietly opened, revealing a breathtaking sunset over Camelback Mountain. The entire dining room seemed to pause for a moment. Guests helped one another capture photos while sharing smiles across tables — one of those rare moments when a restaurant becomes more than a place to eat.

To close the evening, we shared the Housemade Chocolate Brownie with Vanilla Bean Gelato — warm, indulgent, and the perfect ending to an extraordinary night.

Rebecca, thank you for your incredible guidance throughout the evening. Your warmth, knowledge, and attention made our first visit unforgettable. You are truly exceptional at what you do, and Team Wolf is lucky to have you in the pack.

5 stars – A standout date night spot!

We had an absolutely lovely evening at Wolf by Vanderpump, and it exceeded our expectations for a special date night. The atmosphere is chic and energetic. The views of Camelback Mountain add an extra wow factor, especially as the sun sets.

The food was innovative and delicious from start to finish. Every dish felt reimagined and thoughtful, globally influenced flavors with bold, decadent twists that kept us excited bite after bite. We loved how creative yet approachable it all was; nothing felt overly fussy, just genuinely tasty and memorable.

Service was nearly perfect and our server was attentive, knowledgeable, and made the evening flow effortlessly. The one minor hiccup was having to box our own leftovers, which felt a bit out of place at an establishment of this caliber. It's a small thing, but for the price point and level of polish elsewhere, I'd expect the staff to handle that detail seamlessly.

Overall, it was a fantastic experience. We left smiling and already planning our next visit. We can't wait to return again and again to try more of the menu and soak in that vibrant vibe. Highly recommend for a romantic night out or celebrating something special!

If you're a fan of Lisa Vanderpump's style, this place captures it beautifully; untamed yet refined. We'll definitely be back! 🐺✨

reviews.text:
I recently visited Wolf by Vanderpump in Scottsdale, and the space is exactly what you’d expect from Lisa Vanderpump. The entire restaurant is very Vanderpump-forward dark, glamorous, and dramatic. If you watch The Real Housewives of Beverly Hills, the aesthetic will feel very familiar. The decor, lighting, and overall vibe are beautiful and definitely one of the highlights.

Service was also very good. The staff was friendly and attentive, and overall I felt well taken care of.

The food, however, was underwhelming and took quite a while to come out. We tried a burger with fries, a Caesar salad with a parmesan crisp, and some appetizers. Nothing was bad, but nothing really stood out either. It tasted like food you could get at many other restaurants in Scottsdale, so it didn’t feel particularly special.

The cocktails were the standout. The drinks were beautifully presented and very enjoyable definitely something I’d recommend ordering if you visit.

Overall I’d give it 3 out of 5 stars. I would still recommend checking it out if you’re a fan of Lisa Vanderpump or want to experience the atmosphere, decor, and drinks. But if you’re going mainly for outstanding food, you may want to explore other options nearby.

reviews.text:
We took my mother out to dinner to celebrate her birthday and she wanted to try this new restaurant.  After reading the reviews, I had very low expectations and was still disappointed.   We got there and were not required to wait past our reservation time, which was great.  That might have something to do with our 5:15 reservation.  We were shown to our table – a very nice table by the window.  The seats were comfortable, but we felt sorry for the next table that apparently didn’t deserve chairs – they had horrible backless stools to sit on.

Our server, Barret, was very friendly.  He took our cocktail order and, when my mother requested a Cosmo, he suggested the Pumptini.  She really enjoyed it – great suggestion.  We placed our orders and the food came out relatively fast.  That’s when things went downhill.  We ordered three different things.  My mother had the BUTTER SEARED CHILEAN SEABASS.  Luckily, as she was the birthday girl, hers was quite delicious – she really enjoyed it.  Another member of our group ordered the BRISKET & TRI TIP BOLOGNESE.  Even though the server claimed it was cooked for 7 hours, it was stringy and chewy.  Not great.  And, there was so little pasta (the cheapest part).  They could have easily added a little more pasta as there was more than enough sauce.  I ordered the BEURRE BLANC SALMON with seasonal vegetables and Pommes Anna.  The server asked if Medium was okay.  Absolutely – that’s the proper way to cook salmon.  When it arrived, it was clear the kitchen didn’t know what medium is.  It was WAY overcooked.  Also, I expected a dish called “Beurre Blanc Salmon” to have beurre blanc on it.  Silly me.  The pommes Anna, which WAS served with the sea bass dish, were conspicuously missing from my plate.  I asked the server about the beurre blanc and he brought me a ramekin of something that was nowhere near a beurre blanc.  It was extremely lemony and runny.  I think I know why they left it off as it was inedible.  If you don’t know how to make a proper beurre blanc, don’t put it on the menu.  The veggies, once I seasoned them properly, were the best part of the dish.

We hoped that dessert would be better.  However, Barret decided we didn’t need dessert.  Right after they cleared the dishes, he brought us the check.  Don't get me started on the ridiculous 3.5% JUNK FEE. So, we paid and left.   (We stopped and got ice cream on the way home).  Also, they made no effort to acknowledge my mother’s birthday.  Classy places will usually make a small gesture (a cheap glass of champagne or a small dessert with a candle.)  Not here.  Even though they knew about it – nothing.  Now, based on how this restaurant responds to negative reviews, they clearly don’t care.  So, this is addressed to any people that are thinking about trying this place.  One word: don’t.

reviews.text:
I went into this experience with low expectations after seeing the reviews, but I still wanted to try it for myself—especially since we had visitors from DC and Texas who thought the view would make for a great dinner spot. Unfortunately, the experience was very disappointing.

The restaurant was extremely busy and chaotic, with too many staff members moving around and no sense of organization. We were given a huge cardboard box-style menu, which felt more overwhelming to hold than helpful. Our server, Nicole, was training another staff member, which may have contributed to the lack of attention to detail.

I specifically ordered their smoked Old Fashioned and clearly requested no syrup. I was told it would be whiskey with bitters and smoke — no sweetness. The drink arrived full of syrup. I immediately asked for it to be taken back and replaced with a simple whiskey on the rocks. What I received instead was a watered-down whiskey with multiple ice cubes, instead of a proper single large cube.

We also ordered two burgers with one patty each, and they arrived incorrectly — one burger had one patties. Communication throughout the service was poor. Even simple requests like ketchup required long waits just to locate our server.

To make matters worse, we were charged twice for the drink, and the burger adjustment was not corrected, despite the errors and the items being sent back.

While the food quality itself was okay, the service was not. There was a complete lack of attention to detail, follow-through, and communication — which ultimately defines the dining experience more than the food alone.

Would I return? No — not at all.
Good view, decent food, but the service completely overshadowed the experience.

I was not offered a refill on my Diet Coke. By the time the issue was addressed, confidence in the kitchen was already gone, so we declined a remake.

Around 7:30 we reached back out asking when our table would be ready because we hadn't been updated at all and we were told about 5 minutes only to be sat more than 15 minutes later. Once sat we found dirty utensils under the table. Interested in trying a pumptini? They were out:/ Goat cheese balls were EXTREMELY underwhelming. reviews.text:
We visited Wolf with an out-of-town guest and were overall very disappointed.

Despite having an 8:00 pm reservation, we weren’t seated until 8:30 pm. A 30-minute wait with a reservation felt unnecessary.

Our server was wonderful. Friendly, charismatic, and truly the highlight of the night. The appetizers were great, but unfortunately the entrees were not. Everything was extremely salty. My salmon was completely over-salted.

The menu was also very unclear for gluten-free diners. Our server tried to help, but mentioned the kitchen is still “working out kinks” and that dishes can be inconsistent, which was concerning. There was a lot of guessing around what was actually gluten-free.

Our guest ordered the risotto, which was inedible due to an overwhelming amount of red peppers. It was removed from the bill, which we appreciated. Unfortunately, that guest was up all night vomiting afterward, possibly due to gluten cross-contamination or the dish itself.

I’d recommend giving this restaurant more time to work out issues. Gluten-free diners should proceed with caution. Overall, a very disappointing experience.

Went to Wolf last Sunday for my birthday with 2 friends. Beautiful inside, however to be told No bread left, the frose machine was broken, the slaw with the goat cheese balls had no pears to be found, was very dry looked like someone grabbed a handful out of a bag.
I ordered the filet which was great but had to ask twice where my fries were, our waitress never asked how everything was, did we want more drinks. Desert was here yea go, no happy Birthday. All other food was good. To spend over 500.00 for all the mishaps, poor service don't see myself returning.
reviews.author: Susan Grillo

reviews.text: the atmosphere and the design of this establishment is absolutely breathtaking! However service and food could definitely use some work. Drinks and food took forever to come out and the food was so so salty. We ordered the Wolf bread and the butter had so much salt on it that we would be biting down on salt chunks. Same for the mac n cheese we couldn’t even finish it. The drinks were okay nothing special two of the drinks we wanted were unavailable due to the frozen drink machine not working. We also ordered the filet mignon medium well and it came out medium/medium rare when we sent it back it took about 20 min to come out again and when it did they cut the steak, they didn’t do that for the fist one which i thought was weird. My expectations were higher and i will say it was a bit of a disappointment. Our server wasn’t very attentive at all, helping staff was though, my water stayed full which was nice considering there was so much salt in the food.
reviews.author: Natalie Rose

reviews.text: Our waitress Curly Kelsey was amazing!  Made suggestions on the selections and cocktails and was really attentive!
reviews.author: Kim Hackett

reviews.text: This was the most beautiful restaurant I’ve ever been to in Arizona . The ambiance was dazzling and the sunset outside the window overlooking Scottsdale -  was amazing
reviews.author: Amy Lynn

reviews.text:
Valentine’s Day came early for my beautiful wife, and I wanted to completely surprise her.

She’s a big fan of the reality TV shows hosted by Lisa Vanderpump, so when WOLF by Vanderpump opened in Scottsdale—and reservations were nearly impossible to get—I knew I had to make it happen. I managed to secure a 5:15 PM reservation the Thursday before Valentine’s Day.

We pulled up to Caesars Republic Scottsdale, and she still had no idea where we were going. It wasn’t until we reached the 7th floor that I finally told her—and the surprise landed perfectly.

This place is nothing short of amazing. Incredible views, extremely friendly staff, and great service from start to finish. The restaurant was completely packed even at 5:15 in the afternoon, which says a lot.

I don’t drink, but my wife ordered the coconut mojito and said it was fantastic. You have to order the bread—fresh baked and brought to the table with two different butters. Absolutely excellent. She ordered the sea bass, I had the bolognese, and both dishes were very, very good.

For dessert, we shared the brownie. It was solid—not the best brownie in town—but still enjoyable. That said, you’re really paying for the atmosphere, and it delivers. Everyone was dressed nicely, but the vibe wasn’t flashy or over-the-top Scottsdale. Instead, it was laid-back, upscale, and effortlessly classy—a refreshing surprise.

This feels like a place that’s going to be around for a long time. We loved it, we’ll definitely be back, and it was a perfect spot to celebrate being married to a beautiful woman.

— Grandon Group
reviews.author: The Grandon Group

reviews.text: What a great dining experience! Kelsey was so attentive and friendly. She never let our water get low and she was sure to offer us great suggestions. The server assistants were all very kind and helpful - Diego even boxed our food for us. The restaurant is beautiful and has the perfect evening lighting. I can’t wait to return.
reviews.author: Nicole Clifford

reviews.text: Kelsey was fabulous.
reviews.author: Brennan Looper

reviews.text: Came here with my friend on a Thursday afternoon. It is so cool here! Gorgeous interior, the vibe is insane. The rooftop bar is GORGEOUS when you catch it close to sunset hours. We sat at the bar and had Ashley as our bartender. I just want to say, that it was the best experience I’ve had at a bar so far. So incredibly attentive and I was so impressed at how she was able to handle making the drinks for the servers while also tending to us! She made our night with her amazing service! The drinks were amazing!! I recommend the emerald bay Mocktail and the Desert Nectar frozen drink!!!!!!
reviews.author: Doreen Greenlee

reviews.text: I was pleasantly surprised by the quality of the food and drinks at Wolf.  The decor is very much to their theme.  The two appetizers we had the goat cheese appetizer and the lobster ceviche were delicious. We were there for a birthday lunch and we had excellent service the entire time and never rushed.
reviews.author: Mary Magel

reviews.text: Beautiful scenery & food!! I was blown away by the whole experience, really has the Lisa Vandeprump touch of beauty in every detail. 10/10 recommend checking out. Not to mention the rooftop views.
reviews.author: Bella Barbiere

reviews.text: gorgeous restaurant, service was AWFUL. sat for 15 minutes with no service before the host that sat us came over and gave us water and apologized profusely. we were ignored by multiple servers resetting tables around us. our server came by 15 mins later and wasn’t amazing by any means, only mentioned how long we had been waiting when it took her 15 mins to bring our drinks after ordering. only had time for 1 drink due to the lack of service. spoke to 2 male servers when leaving that were both awesome! 2 male bartenders were extremely rude. probably won’t be back due to the poor service and staff attitude. wasn’t busy either, could understand then but it really missed the mark for us
reviews.author: Emmie Cor

reviews.text: We went here for a valentine celebration and had an amazing time.  Started off with goat cheese balls, and the lobster ceviche crisps which were both yummy .  The beet salad was probably the best thing I’ve ever had and Wagyu sliders and french fries were perfect.  The shrimp tacos were so good and filling that we actually took two home.  We were greeted immediately by a gentleman who got us water and then taken care of by Hannah, who was a five star server. She was quick and attentive and friendly, never rushed us , took our picture and had a personality for miles.  We asked to chat with the manager for some complementing, and Parker came over and spent a ton of time with us telling us the history of the restaurant which we thought was amazing.  The decor is incredible. Definitely try to get a table near the window as the view is breathtaking.
reviews.author: kathleen russ

reviews.text: Landis our server was PHENOMENAL!! We will 100% be coming back. He knows his food, he was able to suggest an incredible salad to pair with the goat cheese balls. He made incredible conversation and we felt very taken care of! Thank you!
reviews.author: Gabby Witt

reviews.text:
We don’t like leaving negative reviews, but we feel it’s important to be honest. We had heard through word of mouth that the food at Wolf Restaurant in Scottsdale wasn’t great, but wanted to come and form our own opinion.
Unfortunately, most dishes fell short. The tuna tartare, wolf bread, caviar, and burgers were good, but several items were disappointing. The hush puppies and fish and chips were flavorless, the sea bass was bland, the filet mignon was overcooked and dry, and the Wolf potatoes were awful. The goat cheese balls were just okay, and the salad didn’t come with dressing on the side as requested. Cocktails were nothing special, and the glassware was unpolished and sticky.
With how competitive the Scottsdale restaurant scene is, it’s hard to see this place being successful long term without major improvements.
reviews.author: K Hater

reviews.text: Came here after waste management, and was happy with my experience. The decor was stunning and the food was good. We got a bunch of appetizers and mains. I got tuna tar tar, lobster ceviche and goat balls. Best was the lobster. I got the pork tomahawk and it was good too but a little dry, What really stood out to me the most was the service. Our server was cool and attentive, but server’s assistant Joel was our favorite, he was friendly and helpful. He got us in a good mood before our meal and made us laugh. Will come back.
reviews.author: denise noorlander

reviews.text: Amazing restaurant, loooove the vibe!
reviews.author: Greg Guerrero

reviews.text: Great atmosphere and vibe but the drinks are horrrrrrible! We got 4 different drinks and they were all barely drinkable. So sad!
reviews.author: Catherine Schrader

reviews.text: Im trying very hard to eat at your place to celebrate my wife's birthday.  I cant get to a live person and your voice mail in full.Three days now and not live person I can talk to. I did open table but had questions.  If I cant get through to a live person ill take my money elsewhere.
reviews.author: Susan Crowder

reviews.text: Went for lunch, service was good,atmosphere was nice. The food is awful and very overrated. Would just go and sit at the bar and have a drink. Not worth the money!!!
reviews.author: dina araneo

reviews.text:
This place is gorgeous! If you want somewhere pretty to dine, then this is a great choice.

But... there are service issues. I know they're new, so they're probably working out the kinks, but our reservation was a very early dinner reservation and the restaurant was only about a quarter full when we arrived--we were seated 20 minutes late.

Our table was constantly covered in dirty dishes and glassware. We would push the used dishes to the very far edge of the table to try and "wink wink nudge nudge" the service staff. Nope.

We were also served food when we had no silverware. I had to ask two people to get us silverware and plates and by the time we got them the food was cold.

Also, the water they serve has no ice and is barely cooler than room temperature. Odd. I had to ask for ice.

Now, for the food.

We always eat family style and then bring home leftovers. As such, we tried many of their menu offerings. Here's the lowdown (with the understanding that we all have different taste buds and food preferences).

Appetizers
Signature Wolf Bread: Delicious.
Caviar & Chips: Delicious.
Goat Cheese Balls: Okay.
Lump Crab & Corn Hush Puppies: Delicious.

Entrees
Wolf Burger: Okay.
Tricolore Risotto: Just awful.
Butter Seared Chilean Seabass: Okay.
Prime Filet Mignon: Pretty good.

Sides
Yucca Fries: Pretty Good.
Wolf Potatoes: Awful

I was surprised that, overall, the food was mediocre. Couple that with very slow service, no tableware with which to eat our food, and the constant pile of dirty dishes, I was disappointed. I expected more.

Was it fun to go there once? Yes. Would I go back? No.
reviews.author: M e

reviews.text: Jolene is absolutely stunning and provided stunning service. Incredibly polite and professional. Drinks were 10/10 and goat cheese balls were WOW!!!  Amazing experience, will be back.
reviews.author: Maggie McWilliams

reviews.text: This was our first time at Wolf and it surpassed our expectations! The food and atmosphere were amazing and our server Blake was incredibly helpful and attentive! We love Lisa Vanderpump and her restaurants and we can’t wait to come back!
reviews.author: Brennan Merrill

reviews.text:
Had a great time at The Veranda. The sunset views and live music make it such a fun place to hang out.
Jenny was our bartender and she was awesome — super friendly, really knowledgeable, and easy to talk to. She came up with a few drinks for me on the spot and completely blew me away.
Great vibes, great drinks, and definitely worth checking out. Pretty sure we just found our new local hangout
reviews.author: ATAK GAMING

reviews.text:
The decor is the best part about this place. Lisa knows how to create a stunning space for sure. The rooftop bar with live music and panoramic views of camelback was also stunning. The food is similar to that of the vanderpump restaurant in Paris (Vegas) -mediocre. The drinks were embarrassing.

First- cocktails on the rooftop, my old fashioned was served in a plastic cup on the rocks.

Downstairs for dinner- they were doing a photo shoot for the restaurant and the hostess stopped helping us and everyone else to take pictures with her coworkers. When we were finally seated, the music was so loud we had to shout to speak to our group. The service was good but a little slow. Goat cheese balls were overpowering. Bread loaf was tasty but nothing to really write home about. The bolognese was the biggest disappointment- over sized unseasoned noodles that were too thick to absorb any of the gravy. The meat sauce itself was delicious but the noodle ruined the dish.
The side of fried potatoes came out burnt to a crisp (literally black) Shrimp tacos were good, filet was decent.
Our very nice server did her best to make up for it, she brought us a dessert, and a round of the most disgusting espresso martinis we’ve ever had.

I know they’re new and trying to work the kinks out but they have a lot of work to do. Go for the ambiance/photo opps but don’t expect a nice meal.
reviews.author: Cynthia B

reviews.text: Gigi and Jolene were an absolute pleasure 10 out of 10
reviews.author: Diana Warner

reviews.text: Well, it wasn't the best! The service was a little lacking, waited 15 min for apps and was told they ran out. The another 30 min for the change. They brought the apps with no plates, another 5 min for the plates and by then the apps weren't hot any longer. Waitress kept avoiding our table and had to ask for updates on our order. After 1.5 hours and watching 5 top get apps and their entrees, we left. I don't believe I'll be going back anytime soon. 😔
reviews.author: john sleeman

reviews.text:
As I sit here, waiting for my lunch. I realize it’s been over 75 minutes since I ordered, and I’ve only had a few bites of an appetizer so far. I might as well type up a review to help the time pass. 🤷‍♂️

This place isn’t worth the wait. I wound up leaving before getting our food delivered. Don’t even bother.
reviews.author: Dalton Kennon

reviews.text: I do not recommend this and it is such a shame. They spent a lot of money on the inside and it is quite fancy however, the food is mediocre at best. Was there for lunch yesterday and the goat cheese balls were fair at best. I had a salad and was offered if I would like to add blackened chicken to it. I said yes. The server came back and said the chef cannot do blackened chicken today. I said OK I will take regular grilled chicken. The chicken came out extremely cold and dry. Very disappointing. The person I was with had the steak salad which she said was very bland and again mediocre at best. We were truly disappointed.  Even after I told the waiter about the chicken being terrible, no one ever stopped by to offer to exchange it for something else or even just to check in on us. We also had the house made iced tea which when it was brought out, it was loaded with seeds. We called the waiter over and told him I don’t think this is normal that we would have iced tea loaded with seeds so when you take a drink, your mouth becomes full of this! We asked him if this was normal and he actually said he’s not sure.
reviews.author: rachael turner

reviews.text: What a gorgeous place!!! Everything was absolutely stunning! The food was delicious! The drinks were so amazing! I had the nectar frozen drink and it was so good, I ordered another! The espresso martinis were perfectly balanced. I got the 14oz rib eye for $79 and it was WORTH it for the amount of food that comes with it! The filet mignon was so tender and flavorful for $59.  The bread was amazingly fluffy and soft with their customized butter. The goat balls were delicious and melts in your mouth! They had a great special on desserts too! We had the churros and LOVED it—it comes with a few dips and ice cream!  Everything was so good! I DEFINITELY will be back.
reviews.author: Grace Niu

reviews.text:
My husband and I wanted to try Wolf for the first time. We decided to grab just dessert after dinner reservations at another place.

Overall, we were disappointed in the service and experience. Service was very very slow. There were a few moments where our server and even other staff were sitting down at a table with their friends for 10-20 minutes while we were waiting for other things. The brownie skillet was good but the cobbler had pieces of the fruit pits and almost thought I broke my tooth a couple times.

Maybe dinner would be better, but we’re hesitant to return again.
reviews.author: Sam Saunders

reviews.text: I want to give an honest review of a dinner i had. First i want to say parking was very easy and 12 dollars isn't terrible for valet although it's free at allot of fine dining restaurants in scottsdale.  We went on Friday the 23rd. I wanted a bar spot for me and a girl friend of mine and 9 was the earliest booking a month in advance for a Fri or sat night. We were asked 3 times to switch to a table upon arrival. If we wanted to wait for a spot at the bar we could and we did. So we got sat 30 min later. The spot we had was the furthest to the end of the bar. The bartender in front of us was making drinks for the restaurant and no one cleared off the bar in front of us from the previous guests ( Lisa would have been mortified ). The bartender that was supposed to be serving us seemed to be too busy at the other end of the bar to come over to us and the one in front of us would try not to make eye contact with us. He also recommended the middle bar for better service which we didn't have a choice we barely got a spot at the bar to begin with even though that's where my reservation was. Drinks not that great. Out of cotton candy for a drink that i wanted since the vodka choices were very limited. I had to switch to a glass of wine. Boring. And food mediocre at best. Here's the best part they left our plates in front of us for 33 min after we ate. Could not find anyone to remove our plates. The previous guests plates and empty drinks sat in front of us too. That was such a disappointment. The restaurant was gorgeous with fun details. Would not recommend for dinner in my opinion. Service was a 5/10 for the hype not worth it
reviews.author: MACKENZIE

reviews.text: Great experience at Wolf tonight. The food and drinks were great. The restaurant and decor was so amazing.  Our server Kelsey was fantastic and very attentive. Special thanks to the hostess Rylee for the excellent table. Everyone in our party had such a fun time. Highly recommend!!
reviews.author: Traci Guerra

reviews.text: Wonderful food/drinks and esthetic.  The restaurant is gorgeous,  but super busy and very loud.
reviews.author: Katlyn Gunder (Kate)

reviews.text:
We wanted a light bite so we decided to order the appetizers and boy, they didn't disappoint.
The goat cheese balls deserve an award. Never tasted anything like them. We also had the tuna tostadas and the bread and both were also amazing. On top of the food l, our server was the best. Highly recommend this place.
reviews.author: Lisa Leonard

reviews.text:
The Hostesses are rude, judgmental and do not treat people of color fairly. If you want to go to a place where young women judge your brand-less attire, and if you can manage to deal with racist girls who look at you up and down, while allowing other people cut in front of you while pretending to forget you were waiting, and if you feel comfortable enough to then decide to spend your money here, at least you can count on the bar staff to make up for the rude encounters at the front door. If it wasn’t for a man by the name of “Richie”, I would tell every person I know to completely skip spending their hard earned dollars here. If you can manage to get past all of this, the food is decent considering the hostile environment you’ve just sat down in. How you are treated at the front door of a restaurant typically sets the scene for the rest of your evening, and in this particular instance the hostesses completely ruined my friends experience and instead of remembering how good the food was, I remembered how these girls made us feel.
I started with caviar and finished with sea bass. My partner had the filet mignon.
I hope they can address this issue. In this economy, places like this need to show respect to all people of color regardless of their own personal beliefs.
reviews.author: Sara S

reviews.text: I was at the bar at Wolf in downtown Scottsdale last night and witnessed a taller male employee yelling at and putting down his female coworkers. It was uncomfortable and unprofessional and really took away from the experience. Hoping management addresses this. Everything else was great!
reviews.author: Jazmin Tapia

reviews.text:
If you’re looking for somewhere to just have a vibe then come here.. service was horrible.. waitress seemed so stressed out she was going to loose it. Food was mediocre and honestly some things way overpriced.. the 3 little ceviche tacos were expensive for what they were and way over salted. We ordered wine on the menu they gave us and when we got the bill it was double the cost, when we told the waitress she  took accountability at fist but then came back with the larger menu to point out that the wine we ordered was actually the correct price she rung in and said that the original small menu we ordered off of it is an old menu and the pricing was wrong but she would still take care of it. Not sure why she needed to point out that at all and why do you have a menu with incorrect pricing.
Overall experience was not great and so disappointing. Hopefully they get it together.. definitely not a place for foodies.
It’s also so insanely loud you can’t hear anything so if that’s your vibe this is your spot.
reviews.author: Nancy

reviews.text: Allison was the most AMAZING server!! She was so fun to talk to and made the vibe 10x better. My birthday was so awesome because of her. Ask for Allison next time you book!
reviews.author: Emilie Jacob

reviews.text: Nice place, but the service is extremely slow. The wolf STEAK wrap literally had just one strip of meat. Drinks are decent, but nothing special.
reviews.author: Alejandra Valdez

reviews.text:
Service from the server and food runner was clunky. We had to ask multiple times for silverware, plates, boxes. They also have no bags to carry your to go boxes. The saving grace was our server assistant Joel. He kept checking in on us and even over heard us talking about shots and upsold us on his favorite. I’m happy he took the time to chime in, because his suggestion was better than the other option we tried. Being in the industry, Joel had the best personality, great attentiveness and grace with handling all our needs. His is caliber is more meant to be a server with how strong and personable he was. We all agreed Joel saved the night for us.
Won’t return, but a big shout out to Joel… thanks for making us feel seen.
reviews.author: Hazel Nutt

reviews.text:
Has potential.
Came with a large group for a birthday dinner. Nine of us. They sat us outside so we couldnt really enjoy the ambiance. So if you are coming with more then 4 people. Maybe ask when making a reservation if you want to sit inside. It honestly bugged me, we were sat next to the pool and seemed like we werent even at the place.

I sent my drink back. Was the blackberry cocktail. Tasted sour and was the consistently of a smoothie. Tried changing to vanderpump rose but they were out. I did get a glass of red and white that were great.

Food. None of us really enjoyed our meals. I had the risotto and add steak. We asked for the steak to be cooked medium. It was super rare ( which i dont hate ) but was very fatty and chewy. The risotto was just ok. The veggies on it were super oily. I didnt eat much.

The goat cheese balls were also disappointing.

Service was just ok. They sat us with one drink menu. I asked the server to bring more. Hard to share one with nine people…
The manager came over to us to welcome us and mentioned they give free shot for birthdays. I asked him again for another drink menu. The free shots were spicy so good for folks who like that.

Overall i would never return. Lots of better places nearby at that price point.

Also i tried a few of my friends cocktails. The aperol spritz and purple gin drink tasted like soap. And no one that got a cocktail even finished their drinks.
reviews.author: Ashley Crisman

reviews.text: What an amazing first time experience at Wolf! Incredible vibe, amazing drinks and everything we ordered was so delicious!  We celebrated a friend’s birthday there and they really went above and beyond to make it special for her. The live DJ is a plus! Great music and vibes. We will be back!
reviews.author: Lulu Bay

reviews.text: Amazing wolf bites, food and drinks! We loved the service and atmosphere.  We highly recommend!
reviews.author: Nick and Rene LOVELY

reviews.text:
Wolf by Vanderpump Restaurant is an experience, not just a meal. From the moment you walk in, the atmosphere is next-level dark, moody, elegant, and buzzing with energy without ever feeling overwhelming. It’s the kind of place where every detail feels intentional.

The food? Truly amazing. Every dish was beautifully presented and packed with flavor, the kind that makes you pause mid-bite and just appreciate what you’re eating. You can tell there’s real care behind the menu, and nothing felt ordinary or forgettable.

Between the phenomenal atmosphere and the outstanding food, Wolf completely lived up to the hype and then some. Perfect for a special night out or when you just want to feel like you’re somewhere iconic. Can’t wait to come back.
reviews.author: Briana Bercovich

reviews.text:
The ambiance and décor are absolutely beautiful, with gorgeous views that really set the tone for the evening. Unfortunately, the food didn’t quite live up to the setting this time around.

The salmon was bland and lacked flavor, even with the sauce served on the side. The baby potatoes that accompanied the dish were overcooked, and the Caesar salad was noticeably dry. The goat cheese balls were subpar, with a crust that had little to no flavor. The slaw that came with the dish was just okay—nothing memorable.

On a positive note, the wine was excellent and ended up being the best part of the meal. Despite the shortcomings, the atmosphere alone makes me willing to give it another chance. I plan to return in about six months to see if there’s been improvement.
reviews.author: Michelle Herd

reviews.text: We arrived in the afternoon and were seated after about a five-minute wait. After being seated, we waited roughly 20 minutes without being approached by a server. We then went back to the hostess stand and were told someone would be coming over shortly. After waiting an additional 10 minutes with no service, we decided to leave. The restaurant was not busy at the time.
reviews.author: Kendall Shawhan

reviews.text: Very slow and untrained service.  Food was ok…. Kind of disappointed.
reviews.author: Cameron Wills

reviews.text: I had a wonderful night at Wolf! The atmosphere was just absolutely beautiful and the food and drink was very tasty. I ordered the Wolf Bread, Goat cheese balls and the Filet and they were all delicious.
reviews.author: camrynlaine

reviews.text: If I could give 10 starts I would. The food, and atmosphere was exceptional. What stood out the most was our server Amy. She was the highlight of the evening, honestly she is simply wonderful and I will request her every time. Nice when you have a server who is makes you feel like you’re with a friend
reviews.author: Amber Paris

reviews.text: Absolutely loved this place. We tried a lot of variety from the menu and everything was fantastic. Highly recommend.
reviews.author: Jessica Bovia

reviews.text: Bread is a good starter.  Drinks were beautiful.  I do not recommend the risotto.  Burger and Mac n cheese were good.  Beautiful decor.  Attention to detail… exquisite.  Lovely space!  Wait staff were nice, but rather young and inexperienced.
reviews.author: Victoria Mattera

reviews.text: The music "atmosphere" was so loud and its bass so "thumpy" that my wife, daughter, and I could hardly communicate. I don't even remember the food because we were so anxious to leave. Except for the bread: delicious.
reviews.author: Jim Bennett

reviews.text:
I wanted to love this place, I really really did.
I am a huge LVP fan and was excited to learn she was opening a restaurant in our neck of the woods.
My husband obliged my curiosity and agreed to trying out Wolf for our date night.
The ambiance is delectable with every detail accounted for. I remarked at how each patron would take their seat and begin to look around at the mesmerizing atmosphere.
We were seated without a drink menu, weird but ok. When asked what drinks we wanted the waitress quickly remedied the situation and presented us with a drink menu.
We ordered Wolf bread for an appetizer. Chilean Sea Bass and the filet for our main course and the brownie for dessert.
The food was good, but I expected more. The filet was not a great cut and had a lot of fat and sinew in it. The seabass was good! The bread, although delicious and piping hot was served with two balls of ice cold butter. Have you ever tried to butter a piece of warm bread with ice cold butter? It doesn’t work. The bread comes out on a cutting board stabbed with a bread knife (reminds me of the good ole days in college going to the fine dining of Outback Steakhouse and getting the free bread appetizer ;)). This bread is not free. It is $16. Are you kidding me? A loaf of bread should never be $16. The seabass and filet were priced reasonably at $59 each. The brownie was delicious and nice and moist however the ice cream on top tasted as though it went bad, like sour milk.
As for the service, I expect more. You are in the area of Maple and Ash, Ocean 44, Maestros, etc. you need to step it up. Our main entrees came out five minutes after the appetizer, so not timed well. A steak knife was not provided to my husband for his meat. He ended up using the bread knife from the wolf bread to cut the meat (again the sinew made it such that a butter knife did not work). Our water was never refilled until the very end. It’s little things like this that need to improve in order to compete with the other swanky restaurants of Scottsdale. To top it off, we noticed we were charged a 3.5%  fee  (I presume for CC), but HOW TACKY! We spent $40 on two drinks alone, and our entire bill came to over $200 for the mediocre food and service and on top of that we are charged a 3.5% convenience fee? I expect better than that. Overall that left a taste of “nickel and dimey” in my mouth. Needless to say, we gave it a go, I was able to eat at a LVP restaurant, but we won’t be back. We will stick to Maple and Ash, and the others in the area. Sorry Lisa! Huge fan of you but not a fan of Wolf.
reviews.author: Tara Alfano

reviews.text: Very beautiful fancy decoration!! Highly recommend 💥
reviews.author: Renew Wellness

reviews.text:
WOLF by Vanderpump is an absolute must-visit in Scottsdale. From the moment you walk in, the atmosphere is bold, stylish, and full of energy exactly what you’d expect from Lisa Vanderpump.

The design is stunning, the cocktails are creative and well-crafted, and the food was delicious. One of the highlights is the incredible views of Camelback Mountain, whether you’re dining during the day or enjoying the sunset  it adds such a special Scottsdale touch to the experience.

The entire vibe feels fun, elevated, and memorable perfect for date night, girls’ night, or celebrating something special. Scottsdale’s dining scene just got even better, and WOLF by Vanderpump truly delivers on experience, ambiance, and flavor.
reviews.author: Lori Jones

reviews.text:
It was my first experience at Wolf by Vanderpump, and it did not disappoint. The atmosphere and interior design is incredible. The views at sunset are stunning with Camelback Mountain in the background.
The food was delicious and well prepared as ordered.
The female bartender was very kind, friendly, knowledgeable and enthusiastic.
I’ll be back again soon indeed!
reviews.author: Scott Timmons

reviews.text: Food was good but nothing special. Our waitress Alison was excellent. She was friendly, attentive, and made the experience a really pleasant one.
reviews.author: Armando Acosta

reviews.text: Overall good experience. I have some feedback for management. We went on a Sunday at 6:15 and there were many items not available on the menu. Two of the three appetizers were unavailable, Pinot Noir was unavailable, and the hot honey butter for the bread was unavailable. Just a weird way to start the meal. Our server was slow at first as she overly chatted with other tables that came in after us, but she finally recognized her delay and apologized. The table for 4 was slightly too big and made it difficult for confidential girl talk or intimate conversation. You kind of had to raise your voice.   I really like the movable light on the table to help read the menu and the fur chairs were fabulous. Also the birthday churros were so nice! Food came out quickly.  You need more signage at the street level because the restaurant is hard to find.
reviews.author: Rachel Beneke

reviews.text: Truly so disappointing. The servers were all very sweet but it seemed like no one was actually running thr restaurant, not a manager in sight. We went at 12pm on a Saturday it was not that busy. It took quite some time to be greeted and get an order but we weren't in a hurry and again our server was very nice but it took soooooo long before our drinks and app came another server came over and asked if anyone had helped us at all. They said the kitchen was very behind and they were down a bartender. When we finally ordered they were out of the Ocean Carpaccio.....its mid day and you just opened but ok? We had to send back one dish that was basically uncooked and the beets and tomato dishes were very mid. It was expensive, took forever, and with multiple mess ups pretty surprising a manager didnt even swing by or even appear to be present anywhere? I would definitely skip this or at least wait a few months until they hopefully figure it out.
reviews.author: Kat Wingate Brown

reviews.text: The atmosphere at LVP can’t be beat. We went within their first month open, so I know they’re still working out the service kinks (it’s packed every single night). Parking was easy with either a lot or valet available. The drinks were super fun, too, we had an old fashioned and a mocktail. Food was good overall: goat cheese balls & Caesar for an app. I ordered the crudo carpaccio and my husband got the burger for dinner. Beautiful presentation, but the burger was a little dry.
reviews.author: Jenna Neumann

reviews.text: Great food, fabulous cocktails and great service from friendly staff.  Not to mention the atmosphere!  Stunning!
reviews.author: Megan Cox

reviews.text: We were there 3 nights after the open. Sat at the bar for cocktails and bites. Wings were great and big and juicy and drinks good too. We brought another out of town couple back last night because we thought it was a fun place. Personnel was great from hostesses to wait staff and bussers however, the food was very disappointing. We ordered wings again but this time they were way over cooked and tiny (like qual legs). We got the caviar and the serving size was so tiny it was comical. Then we sat for dinner and two of us got the Fish & Chips which was so greezy I only ate 1/4 of the 2 pieces for $30. Two others in our group got burgers and said they were pretty good but do you go to a Vanderpump place for pub food? We will go back but just for cocktails because atmosphere is fun.

reviews.text: What can I say bu I am so excited to try a new vibe in Scottsdale, new to area, from Minnesota. Love dogs and are they welcome Lisa, we have Maya she is a small joy ball of fun, can my mom bring her? I will to drive she can't navigate the are due to traffic. Big city big fun.💯🐝🏌

They graciously comped those first delayed drinks. We didn't ask either.. thank you kindly! Everything was just perfect. Steak on point, sea bass excellent. Apps so good....
