reviews.text: Enjoyed the Saturday evening DJ, but the menu leaves something to be desired for a location of this caliber in a foodie city such as Scottsdale. The bar back was far more helpful then the bartenders. Loved the chandeliers and the wheels. - J. #SuperFastRacing

reviews.text: We’ve been to a few of Lisa Vanderpump’s restaurants, and hands down—this one is our favorite. The atmosphere and décor are absolute perfection, the Scottsdale views are unreal, and the service was a solid 5 stars. The food did not disappoint either (hello goat cheese balls and the bolognese 🤌). Highly recommend, and we’ll definitely be back—no question.

reviews.text:
Don’t let the bread deceive you, it is hands down the best bread I have ever had and that is saying a lot coming from a true carb lover. Every dish we ordered was incredible, with food that felt light, fresh, and perfectly balanced while still being full of flavor.

The setting is unique with a fun, energetic vibe that makes it perfect for a date night or a night out on the town. The location is also ideal, right between the mall and Old Town, making it easy to stop in before or after exploring the area.

Wolf exceeded all expectations and we absolutely cannot wait to come back.
reviews.author: Kelsee Kaye

reviews.text: I went for lunch and was so impressed with the decor, vibe and view.  The setting puts you in a great mood before you sit down. We were greeted and served with warmth and efficiency by Nicole. Food was delicious.  Gem Caesar salad and a burger.  Perfect size and taste.  I’d go back and bring visitors so they can enjoy the view and food too.

reviews.text: The restaurant and atmosphere are beautiful. My friend ordered Lobster cevice, she got 3 tiny Lobster tacos. I ordered risotto. It looked nice plated, when I tasted it, my mouth burned from how salty it was. All I could taste was salt. It was inedible, so I ordered chicken wings instead. Presentation was nice, the taste very bland. Wings were big in size, which tells me low quality, possibly growth hormones. 3rd friend had beef dish and he said it was fine, but he was still hungry and he ended up eating the wings I ordered. Another friend had steak and he liked it.  The Drinks were good.
reviews.author: Victoria Mitchell

reviews.text: This is a cool spot for pictures and I herd the drinks where bad my drink was amazing but my waiter he made something special for me because I wasn’t feeling the drinks on the menu. The food is not good it’s cool if u just need to grab a quick bite but I wouldn’t go here for dinner
reviews.author: S Cassels

reviews.text: Amazing decor and atmosphere! My mood was immediately tickled as I took in all the fun and eclectic items. Our server, Nicole, was very personable and friendly. She took very good care of us. Food was delicious and the presentation was superb..
reviews.author: Amy Van Kooten

reviews.text: Went with my family for dinner and cannot express how amazing the food and service was.  Hannah was attentive and took great care of us.  We all tried something different on the menu and everything was delicious.
reviews.author: Jose Iturri

reviews.text: Spent over $200 for our 4 year anniversary. Didn’t finish any of our 4 cocktails. And only finished 1 of the 5 meals and sides we got. Only reason I finished mine was because I spent $40 on a single meal and wasn’t going to let it go to waste. Did not get a dessert or drink or anything for our anniversary. Nothing special done or shown for us with them even knowing it was an anniversary dinner and was put on our reservation. Looking at the comments I see I won’t be getting any type of refund or service other than a sorry for the inconvenience. Definitely a disappointment to my fiancé who loves Lisa Vanderpump but this was just very disappointing all around for a special occasion all around.
reviews.author: Chris Matty

reviews.text:
We visited WOLF on New Year’s Eve to celebrate my mom’s birthday, and the experience was wonderful. While it wasn’t my first time there, it was my first time experiencing the service from start to finish, and it exceeded my expectations.

The atmosphere was fantastic, lively but not overly loud, making it perfect for table conversation.

The food and drinks were superb. I ordered the fish and chips, and it was absolutely delicious. The presentation was just as impressive as the flavor.

The waitstaff was equally outstanding. Our water glasses were never empty, and our waitress was incredibly attentive and accommodating, especially when it came to celebrating a birthday.

After reading some of the other reviews, I’m honestly a bit surprised. While I understand experiences can vary, ours was excellent, and I would absolutely recommend giving this place a chance.
reviews.author: Tana Hughes

reviews.text: Such a cool bar, Matt was our bartender and he was awesome. Had really good drink recommendations and was super friendly. Definitely a great place to visit if you’re coming into town or as a regular!

reviews.text: matt made my engagement so special he is actually the best bartender suggested all the best cocktails and was very knowledgeable we love matt! coming back just because of him

reviews.author: Gian Passarelli

reviews.text: Had an amazing experience at Wolf! Great food combined with excellent service and unique atmosphere that I haven’t seen anywhere else. The decor and vibes of the restaurant made it a fun night. Would highly recommend checking it out!

reviews.text: Truly impressed by the atmosphere—elegant, inviting, and thoughtfully designed. The service was polished and professional, and the food was top tier in both presentation and flavor. A wonderful dining experience overall.
reviews.author: Brianna Hensley

reviews.text: All the food we got was great! Service was quick and very helpful. I’ve been back twice and it’s been great every time!
reviews.author: Alec Blomquist

reviews.text:
Food was great and the atmosphere was absolutely incredible!!

If you're in the area this is a must! You won't regret it!
reviews.author: David

reviews.text:
Came here for lunch and tried a variety of dishes, so we were able to get a good feel for the menu overall. They were out of a lot of the drink options but had great views on a rooftop with a fantastic ambiance.

The Famous Goat Cheese Balls were excellent—definitely a standout and something I’d order again. The Campari Tomato Salad with chicken was actually the best dish of the meal: fresh, flavorful, and a great option if you’re looking for something light but satisfying. The Signature Wolf Bread was also very good and served with two different butters, which was a nice touch. Their house-made chips are great as well.

The Lump Crab & Corn Hush Puppies were good but nothing particularly memorable. The Little Gem Caesar with chicken was fine, but note that it does contain anchovies (which is typical for Caesar dressing, but worth mentioning if you’re sensitive to that flavor). The Crispy Chicken Caesar Wrap tasted good, though it felt a bit light on filling.

The Colossal Shrimp Tacos were decent, but I was a little disappointed. The shrimp are Argentinian and flavorful on their own, so frying them added too much breading and ended up muting the overall flavor. They would likely shine more without the heavy fry.

Overall, there were some solid dishes and a few standouts, especially for lunch, but a couple of items could use a bit more balance or refinement. I think with some time and refinement this could be a great place.
reviews.author: Philip Furlong

reviews.text:
Ambience is great… that’s all.
Out of everything we wanted including drinks. Service was very slow and the server seem d like she didn’t know anything about the menus and what they had because she had to keep going back to check.
Dishes were not completely clean and I kept finding hair on everything.
I would expect more from this place. Won’t be back unless things change drastically.
reviews.author: Mitch C

reviews.text: Was a fantastic Restaurant. Food was good and drinks are fun. Don't know how anyone would not like it. Will be back many times. The decor is over the top
reviews.author: Rick Huffman

reviews.text: Beautiful place! Waitresses was great, checked in often for quality control. Gave great recommendations. Food was great! Bar was busy! Churros were amazing! Definitely suggest a reservation
reviews.author: Dakota Slywka

reviews.text: Very slow service and at points purposely was avoided. The food came with challenges mainly the caviar and chips. The chips were stale and broken in small pieces. The cheeseballs were good along with fish/chips and brisket bolognese. The dessert churros were good but ordered two expresso martinis which never came after 30 minutes which is where we were purposely ignored. The waitress likely forgot to enter order and went out of her way to stay away a long time. A better experience would have been for her to own it and make it right. The bottom line is this is not a high quality restaurant, the staff is the main problem. There was zero sign of leadership and staff is not equipped/ready to serve at high level.
reviews.author: will g

reviews.text:
Beautiful build out, stunning views, very fun atmosphere, great drink presentations.  Enjoyed our dinner very much.
Need more training, dinner plates were never removed from the table, even during after-dinner drinks and bill presentation. Minor detail but makes a difference.
reviews.author: Troy Gombert

reviews.text: Such an amazing experience! I dined here with my family, we were sat instantly. I was very impressed with the decor and atmosphere. The service was amazing, drinks came quick with all food coming at the same time. I ordered a dirty martini with blue cheese olives (it came out perfect!) We ordered the bolognese, shrimp tacos, burger, and fish and chips. I tried all four and was extremely pleased with all of the food. My favorite was the shrimp tacos! The music was great and really tied everything together. Will be coming again.
reviews.author: Sofia Iturri

reviews.text: Finally a vibey place that has actual good food & drinks and great service. Shoutout to our girl Sarah! The Mac n cheese was so good I could have had another plate just for my meal. I had the short rib bolognese and it was amazing. I love that their cocktail menu is extensive but the food menu just has a handful of solid delish options. Two things to note that it is pretty loud in there, also the bathroom is in the hotel hallway. Not a big deal just wanted to note it. Decor is such a vibe, very insta-worthy and it just feels upscale but cozy too. I’m waiting for Lisa to turn this place into her next show!
reviews.author: Laila Davidson

reviews.text: Exactly what Scottsdale was missing. The space is moody and fun, but still comfortable enough to actually relax and enjoy your night. The cocktails were solid, food delicious, service attentive, pretty awesome actually. Will be a regular!
reviews.author: Michelle Huffman

reviews.text:
We were staying at the hotel that is place was located and we were only here for one night. We love the decor, the vibe and wanted to come to this place just for a drink or two after our dinner at Ocean 44. The young ladies up front said they were “all booked and cannot accommodate anyone at the bar even just for drinks”. It was 8:30 PM on a Saturday night and we looked in, the place had a bunch of empty tables and the outdoor patio lounge area was completely empty.

I get that this place had just grand opened for a week and wanted to crowd control, but you should be able to accommodate people that just want to go, check out the ambiance and get a drink or hangout in the patio. Nope, “all booked”! Alright, take your “all booked” and lose the revenue and brand reputation.

Good thing Ocean 44 was just as cool (if not better) and they did so well there (food and service). Do better, management, open your bar to allow walk-ins so people can see how great you guys claim yourselves to be. Until then, you guys have earned an amazing 1 star for a cool looking place from the outside looking in.
reviews.author: ToofDocta

reviews.text:
Caesars Republic Scottsdale – Wolf by Vanderpump 🥂
Incredible views, outstanding service, and everything we tried—from the food to the drinks and desserts—was amazing. Highly recommend!
reviews.author: Irma Pinon-Tanner

reviews.text: The service was terrible and the food was blah. They got our reservation wrong and were not able to provide us with a high chair. They ran out of caviar and did not comp anything for our bad experience. The bathroom for the restaurant is also the pool and gym bathroom. This restaurant is not up to Lisa Vanderpump standards in my opinion. We will not be dining here again.
reviews.author: Brooke

reviews.text: I was pleasantly surprised by Wolf! I’m a Vanderpump fan but the food at Vanderpump a Paris fell a bit short. We were taken to our table and got water service immediately, our drinks took no time at all despite being busy and our food came so fast it was almost too fast! Haha! Prices were very reasonable and they had a good wine list despite being a cocktail focused restaurant. Ken’s fish and chips were divine! I judge harshly since I haven’t had any as good as Brighton Beach a few years back! The burger was just ok, the meat needed to be seasoned a bit more. Overall I am THRILLED that they took this meh space and turned it into a super vibey spot with good food!

Hostess Shayla gave us a personal tour of the restaurant.  The outdoor terrace is beautiful.  We can't wait for our next visit - Great job Wolf!

reviews.text: Sophisticated and elegant vibe. Great view of Camelback Mountain with the windows open the bread with the hot honey butter is a must. We also ordered the Wagyu short rib Bolognese completely fire🔥. My wife got the 8 ounce fillet, which had some sort of glaze on it with a flavor l've never experienced in my life absolutely delicious. We took the churros to go and ate them on the way home very yummy. Highly recommend nothing like it in Scottsdale

reviews.text: Hands down THE best Fish & Chips I've ever had. Amazing beautiful atmosphere overlooking Scottsdale and even Camelback, makes a great date night or night with friends, especially given probably the best and biggest cocktail menu in the state.

reviews.text: Wolf was everything I thought it would be and more. The restaurant is beautiful and the food is amazing. Cannot wait to be back!
reviews.author: Paige Duggan

reviews.text:
Wolf Scottsdale did not disappoint. If you’ve been to any of LVP’s other restaurants you immediately know it’s one of her places just walking in. The vibe and atmosphere at Wolf are completely on point from the bar, tables, chairs, chandeliers, decor, layout, etc.

The cocktail list was a good size with different options from vodka, gin, tequila, and bourbon based drinks. We tried 5 different cocktails and all were excellent! The espresso martini might have been one the best I’ve ever had.

For food we had the goat cheese balls, the crab & corn hushpuppies, the bolognese and the sea bass. All were very good…I absolutely loved the bolognese.

Three days after opening they were very busy but service was good, friendly, and professional. The manager even checked on us at least twice as he was running out and made time to say thank to us for coming in on our way out.

Come to impress because that is part of the atmosphere. This place is the epitome of Scottsdale and everyone came out dressed to the 9’s. We will definitely be back!!

reviews.text: Amazing owners!!! They are the best

reviews.text: Mario was very personable, very friendly and made us feel very special. He should be promoted to manager position with his people skills. Even the the couple next to us had such a good time talking to him

reviews.text: The décor was my favorite part of the experience; Lisa Vanderpump did an amazing job creating a space that feels both glamorous and inviting.” The food was delicious, serve was excellent. Can’t wait to go back.

I loved the intentional decor, and I cant wait to come back to order the wings again, and really try everything on the menu!

She took the time to walk us through the menu made the best drink suggestions and shared her favorite appetizers which were all spot on. She was so sweet knowledgeable and genuinely made the night better. Always smiling and polite.

The rest of the staff was just as accommodating and friendly which really says a lot about the place. Huge shoutout to Jacob the busser who was seriously the nicest. Our table was always clean waters always full and he did it all with the best personality.
